retirement_scope: Only enumerated new artifacts from this unit. Prior committed success/acceptance, game assets, original saves and user skill directories remain unchanged. Superseded report hashes are historical identities, not available sources after retirement.

resolved_drafts.finding: Probe omitted scenario argument; apparent missing timeout report was a normal read, not a supervisor hang
resolved_drafts.resolution: Pass exact scenario; preserve refused conclusion, no desktop call

resolved_drafts.finding: Unexpected worker exit could yield supervisor exit0; constructor failure cleanup receipt could be lost
resolved_drafts.resolution: Require close acknowledgement, natural root exit0, empty Job, closed handles and no force/error; preserve constructor receipt

resolved_drafts.finding: Worker could close between arm and next loop before acknowledgement was consumed
resolved_drafts.resolution: Reuse exact response authentication on signalled worker exit

resolved_drafts.finding: Already retained child wait0 entries do not necessarily contain an exit-code field
resolved_drafts.resolution: Require actual recorded root37 with get; authenticate/reuse completed cases without inventing child exit codes

resolved_drafts.finding: Fixed wire could not reach it, but original readonly class inherited a legacy repair writer
resolved_drafts.resolution: Retain original class, add v2 hard rejection and three offline gate checks

resolved_drafts.finding: Root wait0/code0 and close ack observed while signalled child was momentarily still listed; frozen finish labelled containment forced
resolved_drafts.resolution: Bounded natural Job drain only after legitimate close/root0; retain controller/cancel/deadline guards and reject late drain; never rewrite old forced result

resolved_drafts.finding: Strict compile and PE checks passed; report identity helper rejected compiler paths outside repository
resolved_drafts.resolution: Use existing external-path identity helper; seal same generated code/executable without recompiling

resolved_drafts.finding: Known unsuitable isolated desktop context was used once and rejected foreground HWND0
resolved_drafts.resolution: No game/desktop mutation; subsequent probes use the established host execution channel. Not classified as D3D failure.

resolved_drafts.finding: Embedded supervisor and independent receipt equality/close ancestry not initially checked by reusable validator
resolved_drafts.resolution: Offline validate-only recheck against same actual source; no additional desktop run

remaining: Native recovery writes need authentic current release/mutation provenance.
D3D adapter/display mapping and original asset cwd must be bound before an interactive GAME test.
Real GAME publication/wait/result consumption and full original acceptance remain incomplete.
